mechanism: Chlorthalidone-induced hypokalemia and hyponatremia may potentiate letrozole's adverse effects; both drugs can cause electrolyte disturbances and letrozole may increase fluid retention risk.
action: Monitor electrolytes (potassium, sodium) regularly; consider potassium supplementation or alternative antihypertensive if electrolyte abnormalities develop; assess fluid status in patients on letrozole.
